question: Under what condition does applying meditation after worship of the circle produce a sustained contemplative state in this practice?
premises: Worship of the circle must precede the act of meditation.
The application of meditation is limited to the duration specified.
The practice links ritual worship to sustained meditative effort.
inference: Sustained meditation follows only when it is applied for the stated duration after worshipping the circle.
uncertainties: The exact temporal limit of yāvat remains context-dependent.
plain_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as is required.
